mapper.sql: id, operator_id AS operatorId, module_code AS moduleCode, action, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId, detail, created_at AS createdAt

where.if: AND ( action LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR target_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR target_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR detail LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log (operator_id, module_code, action, target_type, target_id, detail) VALUES (#{operatorId}, #{moduleCode}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{detail})
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM operation_log
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
